in_sanskrit.name: प्रतिक्
in_sanskrit.meaning: समस्त पूर्णता के साथ वापस आना
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who comes back to the whole, the one who returns to the absolute, the one who is the counterpart or equal to all

in_tamil.name: ப்ராதேஜ்
in_tamil.meaning: விருத்தம் படிக்கையில் ஒவ்வோருக்கும் அல்லது ஒன்றுக்கும் இடம் பெற்றும் இந்தரியம் அளியது
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who comes back to each and everyone with love and affection

in_telugu.name: ప్రహేదిక్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the supreme ruler, the one who is superior to all

in_marathi.name: Prateik
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prateik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prateik means 'gifted', 'unique', 'distinct'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prasanna' which means 'pleased' or 'gratified'. This name is given to a child who is believed to be a special and unique gift from the gods.
